summary: Polls Miles audio sample playback status through AIL_sample_status (0x0059E3C8). Loads the sample-handle pointer from this[22] (offset 0x58); if non-null, queries the sample handle stored at the indirection offset 0x68 (this[0x58] + 16). If the status is 4 (DONE) or 16 (STOPPED), returns the loop-mode flag this[5] (offset 0x14) as a non-zero verdict; otherwise returns 2.

local_names.v2: sample-handle struct pointer loaded from this[22] (offset 0x58)

operations.description: Load v2 = this[22], the sample-handle struct pointer at offset 0x58
If v2 is non-null, proceed to query the sample status; otherwise fall through to the blocking return of 2
Call AIL_sample_status (0x0059E3C8) with the sample handle read at the indirection this[0x58] + 16 (offset 0x68); store the status into v3
If the status v3 equals 4 (DONE) or 16 (STOPPED), return the loop-mode flag; otherwise return 2
On DONE/STOPPED return this[5] != 0, the loop-mode flag read at offset 0x14 (non-zero means continuous/loop)
Otherwise (null handle or status still active/other) return 2

unresolved: Meaning of the return value 2 (still playing or unknown status) is not grounded from the packet.
The object class owning this audio polling state is unknown.
